channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Earl Watson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Earl Watson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Robert Sarver on Earl Watson
item.description:
Robet Sarver:

“I don’t know how to prove I didn’t do something. Friends and colleagues, white and Black, who attest they’ve known me for 10 and 20 years and have never heard me use language like this or behave in a racist or sexist way are told their own experiences with me aren’t relevant. There was only one named source in the entire piece to stand behind these accusations, former coach Earl Watson. I understand that he is frustrated with me because we terminated him.”

Robert Sarver on Earl Watson, Nov 5, 2021. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Earl Watson
item.description:
“I’d like to see, maybe, Earl Watson get the job. I know Earl personally. I think he has coaching experience in the league. Obviously, he went there, he’s alumni, so I think he’s a good fit.”

Lonzo Ball on Earl Watson, Jan 5, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Jay Williams on Earl Watson
item.description:
“I see Mr. Earl Watson, the head coach of the Phoenix Suns, coming back home to UCLA,”

Jay Williams on Earl Watson, Mar 22, 2017. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Earl Watson
item.description:
GMRyan McDonough on new Suns coach Earl Watson:

“He reminds me a lot of a young Doc Rivers ... They both have a presence about them.”

Ryan McDonough on Earl Watson, Apr 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.
